newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens 0.5 pct down, tracks U.S. loss.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens 0.5 pct down, tracks U.S. loss.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened modestly lower on Monday, pressured by a sharp setback on Wall Street last Friday triggered by worries that the FOMC may raise short-term rates on Tuesday.

The FTSE 100 index -- which has enjoyed a string of record highs recently -- was down 24.5 points at 4,669.4 by 0737 GMT, with 90 stocks in negative territory. Traders said a shortage of stock was helping to cap potential losses in the wake of a 139 point slide on the Dow just ahead of the weekend.
"The market may yet sag after the FTSE future starts trading," said one dealer. "Market makers would dearly love to take this market down quite a reasonable distance."
